founder.title: Al Azmeh Paints – Excellence and Vision Since 1955
founder.description:
Born in Damascus in 1918, Ehsan Ezzat Al Azmeh began his career in 1938, assisting his father before starting his own business in the mid-1940s through import and export — focusing on decorative paints. His growing passion for this field led him to purchase a small factory and begin producing paints locally. Through hard work and continuous learning, he quickly succeeded and later founded a modern paint factory to meet Syria’s increasing demand.

Known for his integrity, ambition, and dedication, Mr. Al Azmeh earned deep respect from everyone who worked with him. He passed away in 1998, leaving behind one of Syria’s most advanced paint factories, now managed by his sons, Engineer Maher and Chemist Samer.

companyOverview.title: Company Overview
companyOverview.text:
Established in 1955, Al Azmeh Paints was among the first paint factories in Syria. From the start, the company focused on exceptional quality, producing paints that were previously only imported. Over the decades, it expanded to become one of the leading manufacturers in the country.

Today, Al Azmeh Paints covers most coating sectors — decorative, furniture, automotive, industrial, and protective systems — using a wide range of technologies such as alkyd, acrylic, polyurethane, epoxy, and water-based systems. Under the slogan “Quality First,” the company earned the ISO 9001:2008 certification, reinforcing its commitment to excellence and innovation.
